text: s0001-s0005: inherited engine 9394 / 5637; lossless 12-bit dense matrices + byte-table NVFP4 decode + chained draft 9031 / 5427 (bit-identical logits); online-calibrated draft depth 8550 / 5425, repeated 8528 / 5378; DSpark-only control 9118 / 7120. Ruled out by measurement before building: token trees (second-best first draft right 1-5%), short-match copy proposals, 4/5-bit draft copies, command-buffer thresholds. Records in notes/journal.md and notes/summary.md.

s0007 = final source: 8249 synthetic / 5283 natural after 7 idle minutes (s0006, same source started warm: 8248 / 5863). The machine was in a faster state than for s0001-s0004 (16-row cycles 52.5 ms against 57-62), so board differences between submissions are good to about 4%; in-process A/Bs on identical token streams give the size of each step. Gate fusion and attention variants: bit-identical, no gain.

Paired in one machine state: inherited engine 8985 / 5331 (s0008), final source 8249 / 5283 and 8241 / 5276 (s0007, s0009): -8.2% synthetic, -1.0% natural. s0001-s0005 ran in a slower state of the machine (the same inherited engine: 9394 / 5637) and are comparable only among themselves.

DSpark-only control on the final source (s0010): 9021 / 7044 = 1.53x / 1.18x oMLX+DSpark. Final source = s0007 / s0009 (8249 / 5283, 8241 / 5276); inherited engine in the same state 8985 / 5331 (s0008). Remaining ideas each measured at 0-1% in process; engineering ends here.

s0011 = new final: expert slots of 4 pairs with a pair-count branch and one gate/up row pair per simdgroup (bit-identical): 8105 / 5124 against 8241-8249 / 5276-5283 before and 8985 / 5331 for the inherited engine in the same machine state.

End of run. Final source = workspace engine/ (s0011's engine): 8105 / 8096 synthetic and 5124 / 5142 natural in the machine state where the inherited engine measured 8985 / 5331 (-9.8% / -3.9%); 8203 / 5165 and 8333 / 5300 later as the machine drifted slower. DSpark-only control (s0012): 8808 / 6847. 8-token copy match and DSpark veto on copies: not kept.

s0018 = the final source after 16 idle minutes: 8040 / 5143 (16-row cycles 49.6 ms). Five evaluations of the final source: 8040-8333 synthetic, 5124-5300 natural, following the machine's state. End of run.
